parameters.query:
SELECT
  u.userid,
  u.fname,
  u.lname,
  u.lastrequest,
  COALESCE(
    json_agg(
      json_build_object(
        'mapping_id', uum.id,
        'user_mapping_id', uum.id,
        'feedback_config_rule_id', fcr.id,
        'usecase_id', uc.usecase_id,
        'usecaseId', uc.usecase_id,
        'usecase_name', uc.name,
        'usecaseName', uc.name,
        'monitoringType', uc.name,
        'usecase_description', uc.description,
        'minvalue', fcr.minvalue,
        'maxvalue', fcr.maxvalue,
        'minpulses', fcr.minpulses,
        'maxpulses', fcr.maxpulses,
        'minintensity', fcr.minintensity,
        'maxintensity', fcr.maxintensity,
        'minduration', fcr.minduration,
        'maxduration', fcr.maxduration,
        'mininterval', fcr.mininterval,
        'maxinterval', fcr.maxinterval
      )
      ORDER BY uc.name, fcr.minvalue NULLS FIRST, fcr.id
    ) FILTER (WHERE uum.id IS NOT NULL),
    '[]'::json
  ) AS usecase_mappings
FROM "User" u
LEFT JOIN "User_UC_Mappings" uum
  ON uum.user_id = u.userid
 AND uum.active = true
LEFT JOIN feedback_config_rules fcr
  ON fcr.id = uum.feedback_config_rule_id
 AND fcr.active = true
LEFT JOIN "UseCase" uc
  ON uc.usecase_id = fcr.usecase_id
GROUP BY u.userid, u.fname, u.lname, u.lastrequest
ORDER BY u.userid;
{{$json.query}}

parameters.query:
WITH target_usecase AS (
  SELECT usecase_id, name
  FROM "UseCase"
  WHERE usecase_id = $2
), current_active AS (
  SELECT uum.id, uum.user_id, uum.feedback_config_rule_id, uum.assigned_at, fcr.usecase_id
  FROM "User_UC_Mappings" uum
  JOIN feedback_config_rules fcr ON fcr.id = uum.feedback_config_rule_id
  WHERE uum.user_id = $1
    AND uum.active = true
  LIMIT 1
), current_same AS (
  SELECT ca.id, ca.user_id, ca.feedback_config_rule_id
  FROM current_active ca
  JOIN target_usecase tu ON tu.usecase_id = ca.usecase_id
), historical AS (
  SELECT uum.feedback_config_rule_id
  FROM "User_UC_Mappings" uum
  JOIN feedback_config_rules fcr ON fcr.id = uum.feedback_config_rule_id
  JOIN target_usecase tu ON tu.usecase_id = fcr.usecase_id
  WHERE uum.user_id = $1
    AND uum.active = false
    AND fcr.active = true
  ORDER BY uum.assigned_at DESC, uum.id DESC
  LIMIT 1
), default_mapping AS (
  SELECT fcr.id AS feedback_config_rule_id
  FROM feedback_config_rules fcr
  JOIN target_usecase tu ON tu.usecase_id = fcr.usecase_id
  WHERE fcr.active = true
  ORDER BY fcr.id
  LIMIT 1
), chosen AS (
  SELECT feedback_config_rule_id FROM current_same
  UNION ALL
  SELECT feedback_config_rule_id FROM historical
  UNION ALL
  SELECT feedback_config_rule_id FROM default_mapping
  LIMIT 1
), archived_current AS (
  INSERT INTO "User_UC_Mappings" (user_id, feedback_config_rule_id, active, assigned_at, deactivated_at)
  SELECT ca.user_id, ca.feedback_config_rule_id, false, ca.assigned_at, now()
  FROM current_active ca
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM current_same)
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM chosen)
  RETURNING id
), updated_current AS (
  UPDATE "User_UC_Mappings" uum
  SET feedback_config_rule_id = chosen.feedback_config_rule_id,
      active = true,
      assigned_at = now(),
      deactivated_at = NULL
  FROM chosen
  WHERE uum.id = (SELECT id FROM current_active)
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM current_same)
  RETURNING uum.user_id, uum.feedback_config_rule_id
), inserted_first AS (
  INSERT INTO "User_UC_Mappings" (user_id, feedback_config_rule_id, active, assigned_at, deactivated_at)
  SELECT $1, chosen.feedback_config_rule_id, true, now(), NULL
  FROM chosen
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM current_active)
  RETURNING user_id, feedback_config_rule_id
), final_assignment AS (
  SELECT user_id, feedback_config_rule_id FROM current_same
  UNION ALL
  SELECT user_id, feedback_config_rule_id FROM updated_current
  UNION ALL
  SELECT user_id, feedback_config_rule_id FROM inserted_first
)
SELECT u.userid, tu.usecase_id AS "usecaseId", tu.name AS "monitoringType"
FROM final_assignment fa
JOIN "User" u ON u.userid = fa.user_id
JOIN feedback_config_rules fcr ON fcr.id = fa.feedback_config_rule_id
JOIN target_usecase tu ON tu.usecase_id = fcr.usecase_id;

SELECT id, active FROM feedback_config_rules WHERE usecase_id = $3 AND minvalue = $1 AND maxvalue = $2 LIMIT 1;

WITH current_active AS (
  SELECT id, user_id, feedback_config_rule_id, assigned_at
  FROM "User_UC_Mappings"
  WHERE user_id = $5 AND active = true
  LIMIT 1
), created AS (
  INSERT INTO feedback_config_rules (type, usecase_id, active, minvalue, maxvalue, minpulses, maxpulses, minintensity, maxintensity, minduration, maxduration, mininterval, maxinterval)
  VALUES ($3, $4, true, $1, $2, 5, 8, 200, 255, 400, 600, 50, 100)
  RETURNING id
), archived_current AS (
  INSERT INTO "User_UC_Mappings" (user_id, feedback_config_rule_id, active, assigned_at, deactivated_at)
  SELECT user_id, feedback_config_rule_id, false, assigned_at, now()
  FROM current_active
  RETURNING id
), updated_current AS (
  UPDATE "User_UC_Mappings" uum
  SET feedback_config_rule_id = created.id,
      active = true,
      assigned_at = now(),
      deactivated_at = NULL
  FROM created
  WHERE uum.id = (SELECT id FROM current_active)
  RETURNING uum.id
), inserted_first AS (
  INSERT INTO "User_UC_Mappings" (user_id, feedback_config_rule_id, active, assigned_at, deactivated_at)
  SELECT $5, created.id, true, now(), NULL
  FROM created
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM current_active)
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT id FROM created;

      active = true,
      assigned_at = now(),
      deactivated_at = NULL
  FROM activated
  WHERE uum.id = (SELECT id FROM current_active)
  RETURNING uum.id
), inserted_first AS (
  INSERT INTO "User_UC_Mappings" (user_id, feedback_config_rule_id, active, assigned_at, deactivated_at)
  SELECT $2, activated.id, true, now(), NULL
  FROM activated
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM current_active)

WITH target_usecase AS (

  FROM current_active ca
  JOIN target_usecase tu ON tu.usecase_id = ca.usecase_id
), historical AS (

  JOIN target_usecase tu ON tu.usecase_id = fcr.usecase_id

    AND uum.active = false
    AND fcr.active = true
  ORDER BY uum.assigned_at DESC, uum.id DESC
  LIMIT 1
), default_mapping AS (
  SELECT fcr.id AS feedback_config_rule_id
  FROM public.feedback_config_rules fcr
  JOIN target_usecase tu ON tu.usecase_id = fcr.usecase_id
  WHERE fcr.active = true
  ORDER BY fcr.id
  LIMIT 1
), chosen AS (
  SELECT feedback_config_rule_id FROM current_same
  UNION ALL
  SELECT feedback_config_rule_id FROM historical
  UNION ALL
  SELECT feedback_config_rule_id FROM default_mapping
  LIMIT 1
), archived_current AS (
  INSERT INTO public."User_UC_Mappings" (user_id, feedback_config_rule_id, active, assigned_at, deactivated_at)
  SELECT ca.user_id, ca.feedback_config_rule_id, false, ca.assigned_at, now()
  FROM current_active ca
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM current_same)
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM chosen)
  RETURNING id
), updated_current AS (
  UPDATE public."User_UC_Mappings" uum
  SET feedback_config_rule_id = chosen.feedback_config_rule_id,
      active = true,
      assigned_at = now(),
      deactivated_at = NULL
  FROM chosen
  WHERE uum.id = (SELECT id FROM current_active)
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM current_same)
  RETURNING uum.user_id, uum.feedback_config_rule_id
), inserted_first AS (
  INSERT INTO public."User_UC_Mappings" (user_id, feedback_config_rule_id, active, assigned_at, deactivated_at)
  SELECT $1, chosen.feedback_config_rule_id, true, now(), NULL
  FROM chosen
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM current_active)

  UNION ALL
  SELECT user_id, feedback_config_rule_id FROM updated_current
  UNION ALL
  SELECT user_id, feedback_config_rule_id FROM inserted_first
), touched AS (
  UPDATE public."User"
  SET lastrequest = now()
  WHERE userid = $1

)
SELECT
  t.userid,
  tu.usecase_id AS "usecaseId",
  tu.name AS "monitoringType"
FROM touched t
JOIN final_assignment fa ON fa.user_id = t.userid
JOIN public.feedback_config_rules fcr ON fcr.id = fa.feedback_config_rule_id
JOIN target_usecase tu ON tu.usecase_id = fcr.usecase_id;
